output_file: runs/<timestamp>/profile_<id>_matched.jsonl, one file per recruiter, e.g. data/user_search_inputs/profile_a/ -> profile_a_matched.jsonl
one_line_per: job that goes into the recruiter's portal, as one JSON object; a job you leave out is out

job_id.meaning: the job's job_id from the feed, unchanged

profile_id.meaning: the profile_id from the recruiter's search inputs

matched_company.meaning: the company from company_searches.json the job is at, spelled exactly as in the search inputs

matched_job_title.meaning: every title from job_title_searches.json the job matches, spelled exactly as in the search inputs

matched_location.meaning: every location from location_searches.json the job is in, spelled exactly as in the search inputs

reason.meaning: one line a recruiter would understand, why this job is in

used_llm.meaning: true if an LLM call decided anything about this job

extra_fields: fine, v1 adds title, company & location

example.reason: Open Controls Engineer role in Warrington at a listed company

matching_rules.company: The company must appear somewhere on the job page (declared company, heading, title tag, URL or body text), which is only a loose validator to make sure we have the correct career page, because the search upstream already picked this company's jobs. Names match ignoring case, punctuation, a leading The & legal or corporate words after the name such as Ltd, Limited, plc, Group, Holdings, International & UK, so IMC International Group is the listed IMC.
matching_rules.title: Every word of the profile title appears in the job's real title in any order, ignoring case, punctuation & a plural s, and one job can match several titles.
matching_rules.location: A location covers its own name & every town in its includes list, a sub_region (a region, nation or county) also covers any town inside it, and a remote location covers jobs the employer says are remote or home-based in its country. A job that names several places is in if any one of them matches, so Bristol, Manchester is a pass for a recruiter with Bristol, but a job in another country is never inside a location whatever the town is called. One job can match several locations.
matching_rules.live: A recruiter needs evidence the job is live, and a page that returns 404 or 410 is closed & never goes in.
matching_rules.listed_when: The company, at least one title & at least one location all match. matched_job_title lists every title it matches and matched_location every location it matches.
matching_rules.duplicates: A real job appears at most once per file.

labelled_sample: In data/labelled_sample.jsonl, decision is yes (in) or no (out), and yes rows carry the expected matched_company, matched_job_title & matched_location.
